name: pc-mission
description: PC Mission — multi-day Instagram creator outreach campaign manager with AI personalization, official Meta APIs, and Telegram reporting.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run bundle:lambda && npm run build:web
scripts.vercel:build: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:safe
scripts.db:migrate:safe: npm run db:migrate --workspace @pc/api || echo "[build] Migration skipped at build time (DATABASE_URL unavailable); it is safe to run again once the database is reachable."
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @pc/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @pc/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @pc/web
